title_en: LAND AND AN OLD STONE HOUSE FOR SALE IN BALDUSHK
description_en: LAND AND OLD STONE HOUSE FOR SALE. 📍Baldushk is located, 2 km from the main paved road. *The house has a sip. 136.3 m2, built on a plot of 300 m2, with ownership certificate, inherited property. *Around the house, in the form of a hill crown, there is also a plot of land of 17,700 m2 with AMTP, with recognition of borders and a municipal plan, property inherited for generations, planted with various fruit trees and virgin natural greenery. *The property is in a very good position, between greenery and hills. *It is suitable for: *Private country house for holidays *Agroculture for organic agricultural products. *Farm with stables for livestock and poultry. *The old stone house, built 130 years ago and still existing, needs total reconstruction. *Bargain price: €130,000 TRS-19382677
